senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) [place where a thing is put,] sheath, case.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:5">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>יָדוֹן</he>, v. <cite ref="N00231">preced.</cite>) <he>שלא … חוזרת לנְדָנָהּ</he> their souls shall not return to their cases (bodies); Y. ib. X, 29ᵇ bot.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>.—Pl. <he>נְדָנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Ib.</cite> <he>איני מחזיר … לנְדָנֵיהֶן</he> I shall not return their spirits to their cases.
